document: NDP are Favourites to Win Third Term (Global BC, 2024-10-18)
note: Final Ipsos poll before the 2024 election. Mixed mode: n=1,330 (930 online Ipsos I-Say panel + 400 live-interviewer phone). Shares among decided voters from the detailed tables (Q2 reduced base, 'Rebased on decided voters'): https://www.ipsos.com/sites/default/files/ct/news/documents/2024-10/BC%20Election%20Poll%202%20Tables%20%28Oct%2018%29.pdf. n = unweighted decided-voter bases. AUTRES = 'Some other party or candidate'. Region labels verbatim from tables: Metro Van, Van Island, North/Interior (release text: 'Southern Interior/North').
